newsitem.title: USA: United Tech increases stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: United Tech increases stock buyback.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said its board on Tuesday authorized management to buy back up to an additional 15 million shares of common stock over the next two years.

Common stock repurchase authorization by the board since the repurchase program began in April 1994, now totals 45 million shares, it said, and 24.4 million shares, valued at $1.1 billion, had been repurchased through the end of the 1997 first quarter.
"Share repurchase continues to be an important use of UTC's strong cash flow," Chief Executive George David said.
"The share repurchase authorization, together with our 13 percent dividend increase in February, demonstrates our continuing commitment to enhancing shareowner value," he said.
The board also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.31 a share, payable June 10, record May 23. In February the board approved a 13 percent increase in the quarterly dividend to $0.31 from $0.275.
